data.raw_text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY (Sequoyah Hills) - Effective immediately, KUB crews have closed both sides of Kingston Pike between Scenic Drive and Oakhurst Drive due to a tree falling on the power lines. Updates will be posted as conditions warrant.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY – NEW YEAR 2025 🎉
 Cyberabad Traffic Police

📅 31st December 2025 | From 8:00 PM onwards

🚖 CABS / TAXI / AUTO DRIVERS

✔️ Must wear proper uniform & carry documents
❌ Refusal of ride is an offence (Sec 178 MVA)
❌ No excess fares or misbehavior
📲 Complaints: WhatsApp 9490617346

🍻 BARS / PUBS / CLUBS

⚠️ Do NOT allow drunk customers to drive
⚠️ Management will be prosecuted for abetment
✔️ Educate customers & arrange safe transport

🚔 FOR GENERAL PUBLIC

Special cameras for:
• Wrong-side driving
• Signal jumping
• Overspeeding
• Rash driving
• No helmet / parking violations

🍺 Drunk & Drive checks across Cyberabad
📄 Vehicles detained if documents not produced
🔊 High-decibel music, no number plates = seizure
👶 Minor driving = vehicle detention + prosecution

🚨 DRUNK & DRIVING – STRICT ACTION

 Fine up to ₹10,000 / Jail up to 6 months (1st offence)
 ₹15,000 / Jail up to 2 years (repeat offence)
🚫 DL suspension / permanent cancellation
 Fatal accident → Arrest under BNS 2023
 Celebrate Responsibly. Drive Safely. Arrive Home Alive.

 Cyberabad Traffic Police
 For your safety, always on duty

#TrafficAdvisory #NewYear2025 #CyberabadTrafficPolice
#DrinkAndDrive #RoadSafety #CelebrateResponsibly
#SafeNewYear #TrafficRules #PublicSafety
